rules: Freeze this plan and all online configs before key generation and online recovery; no result-dependent tuning or seed replacement.
Same two patterns and backend seeds are paired across both beta/s choices and all weights; all 80 nonzero ternary tails are processed.
Run all scheduled patterns even after success; timeout only censors its own trial. Preserve partial baseline evidence and attempt subsequent trials within budgets.
Per-pattern LLL rows and Babai, then BKZ rows and Babai, precede any lattice sieve database construction. Direct-tail public checking is a separate baseline.

Online wall budget includes every trial subprocess, imports, diagnostics, preprocessing, database build, decoding, validation and supervisor cleanup; setup/tests/generation/offline evaluation are separate.
n128 is bounded exploration with one key per weight, not a success-rate estimate. No push; phase1 files remain byte-identical.
